recipes.name: Berries & Cream Instant Oatmeal
instructions: To a mason jar or airtight container, add the instant oats, freeze-dried berries, flaxseeds, and vanilla sugar.
Mix and store somewhere cool and dry until ready to use.
When ready to eat, transfer to a bowl and add the milk. Microwave on high (600 W) for 3 minutes, stirring once halfway. Alternatively, heat on the stove.
Add more milk for a thinner consistency if desired, or microwave for a few seconds longer for a thicker oatmeal.
Finish with the yogurt, berries, and any other desired toppings. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Make your own 'quick oats' by pulsing regular oats in the food processor. † Vanilla sugar is granulated sugar infused with vanilla beans, commonly used in European kitchens. It can easily be substituted with regular granulated sugar and a splash of vanilla extract. † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium .

Storage The dry oatmeal mix can be stored in an airtight container on the counter, out of direct sunlight for up to 3 weeks. Once mixed with the plant milk, enjoy this oatmeal immediately hot, or leave it in the fridge and have it the next morning as overnight oats.
